summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DNS resolver for the shared 10.100.125.0/24 network using pdns_recursor: it listens on its private address, answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.125.11) via an authoritative-domain A record, and forwards all other queries to the working upstream resolver at 10.100.125.1. node2 and node3 (CentOS Stream 10) were repointed via NetworkManager (ipv4.dns=10.100.125.10, ignore-auto-dns=yes) to resolve through node1. Verified both the internal record and upstream resolution work end-to-end from node2/node3. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id baselines and DNS health on all three nodes, restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time (never concurrently), confirmed each node's boot_id changed after reboot, and confirmed DNS service/config/resolution fully recovered on each node before proceeding to the next.
actions_performed: Inspected OS, IPs, and existing resolv.conf on node1/node2/node3
Located VyOS 2026.04 dns forwarding config tree (authoritative-domain records) via templates since docs were outdated for this version
Verified 10.100.125.1 is a working upstream DNS resolver from node2

Configured node1: set service dns forwarding listen-address 10.100.125.10, allow-from 10.100.125.0/24, name-server 10.100.125.1, authoritative-domain inventory.internal records a @ address 10.100.125.11; committed and saved
Verified pdns_recursor active and listening on 10.100.125.10:53; tested inventory.internal and google.com resolution directly against node1
Reconfigured node2 and node3 NetworkManager connections (ipv4.dns=10.100.125.10, ipv4.ignore-auto-dns=yes) and reapplied
Verified end-to-end resolution from node2 and node3 for both inventory.internal and an external domain
Captured boot_id + DNS health baseline on all three nodes
Rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full DNS recovery
Rebooted node2, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and persisted resolv.conf/resolution
Rebooted node3, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and persisted resolv.conf/resolution
